summary:
In microgravity, fire behaves differently. Without buoyancy-driven convection, flames become harder to predict, detect, and extinguish, posing serious risks to astronaut safety. Yet critical scientific knowledge remains buried in thousands of pages of NASA research reports.

NovaXplore transforms this complexity into an intelligent, visual, and explainable AI research experience.

Powered by five specialized AI agents, NovaXplore retrieves, ranks, analyzes, compares, and synthesizes experiments in seconds, leveraging a knowledge graph of 25 research records, 20,259 nodes, and 73,854 relationships.

What sets NovaXplore apart is its ability to turn scientific evidence into interactive visual insights. Instead of walls of text, users explore data cards, charts, comparison tables, and authentic flame images extracted from original documents.

Beyond visualizing answers, NovaXplore brings experiments to life through interactive profiles displaying facilities, hardware, fuels, operating conditions, and measured parameters.

Every research step is explainable, every claim is traceable to sources, page numbers, and DOIs, and missing data is explicitly acknowledged rather than fabricated.

From fragmented data to connected knowledge. From complex reports to visual evidence. From hours of research to seconds of discovery.

This is NovaXplore.
details:
NovaXplore — Transforming NASA's Research into Interactive Scientific Intelligence

What Does Our Project Do and How Does It Work?

In microgravity, fire behaves differently from how it does on Earth, creating unique challenges for spacecraft safety. Although NASA has conducted extensive combustion research, valuable scientific knowledge remains scattered across thousands of pages of technical reports and experimental data.

NovaXplore transforms these complex archives into an intelligent, visual, and explainable AI research platform.

We collected 1,683 files and 14,185 images from NASA's PSI and NTRS repositories, processing 6,060 text chunks into 384-dimensional vector embeddings. This information is organized into a Neo4j knowledge graph containing 20,259 nodes, 73,854 relationships, and 590 GraphRAG communities.

When users ask questions, five specialized AI agents collaborate to rank relevant experiments, analyze source documents, compare findings, navigate scientific relationships, and synthesize evidence-based answers within seconds.

Unlike traditional chatbots, NovaXplore uses Generative UI to transform research findings into interactive data cards, scientific charts, comparison tables, authentic experimental images, and detailed experiment profiles displaying facilities, hardware, fuels, operating conditions, and measurements.

Every research step is explained, with traceable citations linking findings to original sources, page numbers, and DOIs.

Benefits and Intended Impact

NovaXplore significantly reduces the effort required to explore scientific literature, turning hours of manual PDF analysis into seconds of interactive discovery.

It helps researchers, fire-safety engineers, and students locate relevant experiments, compare experimental conditions, and identify reliable data for scientific analysis and predictive modeling.

By revealing gaps in available evidence, such as limited combustion data relevant to lunar and Martian environments, NovaXplore can also help guide future research.

Our broader vision is to make scientific knowledge more accessible, transparent, and actionable, contributing to safer spacecraft and future space exploration.

Tools, Technologies, and Hardware

NovaXplore combines modern AI technologies with a lightweight web architecture:

  • Backend: Python, FastAPI, Anthropic Messages API.
  • Frontend: JavaScript, React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, OpenUI.
  • Knowledge Layer: Neo4j Aura, Cypher, GraphRAG, sentence-transformers.
  • Authentication & Storage: Clerk, JWT/JWKS, Supabase PostgreSQL, Prisma.
  • Infrastructure: Cloudflare Tunnel, Tailscale, Linux container.

The platform runs on approximately 8 GB of RAM without requiring a GPU at runtime, demonstrating efficient deployment with modest computing resources.

Creativity and Innovation

NovaXplore goes beyond traditional AI-powered document search by transforming how users interact with scientific evidence.

Its innovation centers on three capabilities:

1. Generative Visual Intelligence: Instead of producing walls of text, the AI acts as an interface coordinator, dynamically selecting the most effective visual presentation for each research question. Users can explore not only scientific conclusions but also the experimental configurations behind them.

2. Explainable Multi-Agent Research: Five specialized agents collaborate across a structured knowledge graph, while the interface reveals research steps and connects findings to verifiable scientific sources.

3. Scientific Honesty by Design: NovaXplore prioritizes evidence over confident-sounding answers. Missing information is explicitly acknowledged, unsupported measurements are never invented, and only authentic document imagery is presented as experimental evidence.

Key Factors Our Team Considered

Our development focused on scientific accuracy, accessibility, resource efficiency, and practical feasibility.

We prioritized source traceability and transparent uncertainty because scientific reliability is essential for safety-related research. For example, only 9 of 25 research records contain oxygen concentration ranges, requiring the system to verify source material rather than assume missing values.

We also designed a clean, NASA-inspired interface with multilingual support to make complex research accessible to a broader audience.

Finally, we adopted a P0-first development strategy to deliver the most impactful features within the hackathon timeframe while maintaining a lightweight, functional system.

Conclusion

NovaXplore is more than an AI chatbot — it is an interactive scientific research companion that retrieves, connects, visualizes, and explains knowledge.

By combining multi-agent intelligence, knowledge graphs, Generative UI, and verifiable scientific evidence, NovaXplore transforms NASA's complex combustion archives into an accessible research experience.

From fragmented data to connected knowledge. From complex reports to visual evidence. From hours of research to seconds of discovery.

This is NovaXplore.
